advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: In a review round, the first 2 confirmers of a reviewer get all blocking findings of that reviewer. A third confirmer gets only the findings with one "yes" and one "no".
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/SKILL.md line 27, these 2 sentences copy the procedure of items 1 to 4 of "When a reviewer has blocking findings" in references/review.md, which the agent reads before the self-check (step 8, line 103).
advisory.correction: Remove the 2 sentences. Keep "A **confirmer** is a new subagent that answers "yes" or "no", with one sentence, for each problem in its prompt."
